scope: E5-01 authored supported-subset source adapters to native declarations. Not a Slack/Microsoft interaction backend or UI rendering proof.

source_documentation.use: Native wire, registry and source-format compatibility.
Text wrapping versus clipping; supported size subset.
Action version introductions and navigation semantics.

text: common mrkdwn; explicit application renderer for workspace-dependent tokens
slack.property_policy: Exact allowed fields only; unknown fields, block_id, confirm, option_groups, input/rich_text/context and unresolved workspace identity fail.

actions: Action.Submit (External binding; no in-post input collection)
adaptive.property_policy: Exact allowed fields and declared version introductions; wrap=true required; no dropped inputs, fallback/requires, selection behavior, overflow, weighted widths or unsupported styles.

bindings.object_data: exact JSON-type-preserving External.context match; native escape hatch, not SDK signed context
bindings.url: absolute HTTP(S); optional explicit matching OpenURL without additional query

serialization: Native compiler only. No raw props.blocks/cards passthrough, silent legacy fallback or omitted unsupported siblings. Notification message supplied explicitly by application.
capability_gates: Existing exact referenced UIProfile + client declaration + MmBlocksEnabled gates unchanged; no inferred client support.
output_limits: Existing compiler: total native blocks 100, nested depth 32, combined Text/Button text 16000, registry reconciliation/query limits.
source_policy: Vendor references downloaded into ignored build for protocol inspection only; never executed, copied into runtime, or bundled.
remaining: E5-03 actual web/desktop/mobile client execution and newer-server validation.
E6 onward remain in the original implementation plan.
